name: Rosa Delgado
memories:
She ran a small bakery with my grandfather and got up at four every morning to light the ovens.
She always said "Come in, there's coffee" before you were even through the door.
She sewed all of our Halloween costumes on her old sewing machine, and let us pick the buttons from her biscuit tin.
On Saturday afternoons she listened to boleros on the radio and hummed along while she cleaned.
